featured.headline: Leaked data: 490,334 Russian soldiers dead
featured.label: REPORTED
featured.summary: BBC Russian and Mediazona, analysing leaked Rosstat records, count at least 490,334 Russian dead. True toll est. ~700,000 incl. missing.

featured.headline: KOSPI crashes 6.16% in chip rout
featured.label: REPORTED
featured.summary: Seoul's KOSPI fell 308.52 points to 4,697.51; Samsung −9.87% and SK hynix −11.05% as a sidecar halt kicked in.

featured.headline: US proposes tariffs on 14 economies
featured.label: OFFICIAL
featured.summary: Washington proposes Section 301 tariffs — China capped at 20%, Vietnam up to 35%, the EU 15%. Comments due 5 Jan 2027; hearings from 25 Jan.

featured.headline: Shenzhou-24 lifts off with Pakistan's first astronaut
featured.label: REPORTED
featured.summary: Liftoff 00:18 UTC, docking 03:56 UTC — first foreign astronaut on Tiangong.

featured.headline: US inflation 3.8%; Q3 GDP revised to 4.3%
featured.label: OFFICIAL
featured.summary: Core PCE 3.3%, highest since Nov 2023. Fed hike odds ~97–98% for 9 Dec.

featured.headline: Tanker fire on Cairo ring road kills 31
featured.label: REPORTED
featured.summary: Tanker overturned at Warraq, Imbaba; 27 vehicles burned. 31 killed, 21 injured.

featured.headline: Poland plans no-fly zone on Ukraine border
featured.label: OFFICIAL
featured.summary: After missiles landed in Poland; in force late Dec / early Jan.

featured.headline: Israeli strike kills Hamas security chief in Gaza
featured.label: REPORTED
featured.summary: Col. Abuelouf, his wife and two children killed in Shati camp. IDF confirmed it.

featured.headline: Coalition says it struck Hodeidah port
featured.label: OFFICIAL
featured.summary: Spokesman al-Maliki says the coalition hit the port and targets in Saada and Amran.

featured.headline: Police free all hostages in Cartagena siege
featured.label: REPORTED
featured.summary: ~18-hour siege after a failed armoured-car robbery; ~30 held, one captor killed.

featured.headline: Liverpool beat Club Brugge 3–0
featured.label: REPORTED
featured.summary: Isak brace (13', 82') and Wirtz (79') lift Liverpool to 12 points, 5th.

featured.headline: Australia–Solomon Islands sign security treaty
featured.label: OFFICIAL
featured.summary: Australia becomes primary security partner, no foreign base; A$740m over 10 years.

featured.headline: EU unveils Quantum Act and €50bn tech fund
featured.label: OFFICIAL
featured.summary: Draft act aims to lead quantum by 2030; €50bn is a target, not committed cash.
